## Proof

Let $d$ be the least positive element of $\{ax + by\}$. Division with remainder shows that $d$ divides $a$ and $b$, and each common divisor divides $d$.

See [[Wikipedia|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Group_(mathematics)]].
